name: FinnyShare
overview: Remote access for Jellyfin behind CGNAT - no port forwarding, no static IP
description:
Reach this server from anywhere. No port forwarding, no static IP, no router access, and it works behind CGNAT and on mobile broadband.

Your Jellyfin opens one outbound connection to a FinnyShare relay. Your users, passwords and permissions are unchanged.

Beta: 10 Mbps per server, shared by everyone watching it. No limit on viewers. One relay, and no uptime promise yet.
